input.value: charred kitchen cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls

input.rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and home interior (smoke damage) is clearly property damage. The loss is to the insured's own property, not third-party liability or auto-related.

Moderate fire and smoke damage to kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces, but contained to one room with no injuries and quick containment via extinguisher. Repair costs will likely be above the $500 deductible but well within the $250,000 coverage limit. Damage is significant but not structural or catastrophic.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire (grease flare-up from stovetop) with charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling/walls. No injuries; damage contained to kitchen. Quickly extinguished by policyholder. Policy POL-1001 is active with $500 deductible and $250k limit.
